name: claude-carbon
description: Track the carbon footprint of your Claude Code sessions

showPerTurn.title: CO2 of each answer
showPerTurn.description: Show the CO2 of each answer at the end of the turn duration line. Off: only the session total stays.

showSessionTotal.title: CO2 session total in the terminal
showSessionTotal.description: Pin the session's CO2 total and its API-price cost under the prompt in a terminal. Turn it off when your status line already shows it, such as ccstatusline with the claude-carbon segment. The desktop app keeps it.
